name: slop-detector
description: Catches slop as Claude writes it: refuses a file edit that replaces code with a '... rest of the code' placeholder, and tracks TODO stubs, not-implemented throws, debug prints, @ts-ignore and other leftovers in a band above the prompt and a /slop pane.

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: Also refuse edits that add a placeholder stub (TODO: implement, NotImplementedError, debugger), not only truncation markers.

ignore.title: Ignore paths
ignore.description: Comma-separated path fragments that are never scanned, such as test and markdown files.
